en: Sepia-toned view of a historic village church with a tall, slender spire and clock tower, likely Protestant, next to a half-timbered building. In the foreground is a multi-arched stone bridge over a river, with numerous people—adults and children—standing along the parapet and on the bank. Bare trees frame the scene, suggesting late autumn or winter. The style resembles an early 20th‑century photographic postcard. No visible printed text appears on the image side.
